mentions.name: Nokia 3210 4G Retrofit
mentions.description: This project retrofits a Nokia 3210 phone with 4G connectivity by designing a custom PCB with a modern LTE module that connects to the phone's peripherals. It also involves implementing modern features like GPS navigation and a music player UI adapted to the phone's 84x48 LCD screen, and serves as a way to learn electronics and soldering.
mentions.problem: 2G networks are being shut down within the next two years in most European countries, leaving the old Nokia 3210 without connectivity.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on making an old Nokia 3210 use 4G because 2G is being shut down within the next two years in most European countries.

As it currently looks I need to design my own PCB with a modern LTE module and make it connect to all the peripherals.
mentions.author: josters
